description: Image Description: The image shows a white ceramic toilet with the lid and seat raised, revealing the bowl. The toilet is situated in a small bathroom space with a dark mosaic tile floor composed of small rectangular tiles in varying shades of brown and black. To the right of the toilet, there is a small, cylindrical metal trash can with a lid that has the word "PUSH" embossed on it. A beige towel hangs on a rack or hook on the wall to the right side of the frame
